backend_endpoints: GET /api/analytics/funnel - Returns funnel stages, conversions, time_series, users list
GET /api/analytics/funnel?days=7|30|90 - Filters by last N days
Platform-wide view for super admins (demo tenant) - is_platform_wide=true
Tenant-scoped view for tenant admins - is_platform_wide=false, shows only their users
frontend_components: 5 KPI cards with stage counts and conversion percentages
Stage-to-Stage conversion with arrows and % between each step
User Details table with email, company, role, current stage, signup date, last login
Stage filter dropdown filters the user table
Time range preset buttons (7/30/90 days/All time/Custom)
Custom date range picker with Apply button
Sidebar 'User Funnel' link in ADMIN section
funnel_stages: Signed Up - All users who created an account
Email Verified - Users with email_verified=true OR active tenant status
Onboarding Complete - Users whose tenant has is_onboarded=true
First Upload - Users who have uploaded data (via upload_history or data collections)
Active User - Users with last_login within 30 days

seed_data_creation: None - tested with existing users in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 80 verified complete User Funnel Analytics implementation. Backend endpoint GET /api/analytics/funnel returns funnel stages (cumulative counts), stage-to-stage conversions with rates and drop-off, time_series (daily signups), and detailed user list. Super admins (demo tenant) see platform-wide data, tenant admins see only their tenant's users. Frontend UserFunnelDashboard.jsx has 5 KPI cards, overall conversion bar, two Chart.js charts (funnel breakdown + signup trend), stage-to-stage conversion visualization, and filterable user table. Time filtering supports presets (7/30/90 days/all time) and custom date ranges.
